build_z_head: build a z-regression head from config and input shape using the ROI_Z_HEAD_REGISTRY
create_FastRCNNFCHead: create a FastRCNNFCHead with fully connected layers for z-depth regression predictions
compute_z_rcnn_loss: compute the z-regression loss using smooth L1 loss between predicted and ground truth depth
run_z_rcnn_inference: run z-regression inference to predict depth values for detected instance boxes
review_FastRCNNFCHead_forward: review the FastRCNNFCHead forward pass that flattens input and applies FC layers with ReLU
